pipeline.modality: Selective small-molecule immunoproteasome inhibitor (LMP7/LMP2); subcutaneous lyophilized for reconstitution
pipeline.license_origin: Exclusive license from Onyx Therapeutics (Amgen subsidiary) for non-oncology uses; ex-US partial out-license to Everest Medicines (Greater China + select Asia)

indications.trial_name: PORTOLA (completed) and planned global Phase 2b registrational study
indications.trial_design: PORTOLA: Phase 2a placebo-controlled, double-blind, 24 patients (2:1) 60 mg zetomipzomib SC vs placebo + background steroid taper for 24 weeks. Planned Phase 2b: global, randomized in relapsed/refractory AIH per March 2026 FDA Type C feedback (treatment duration, endpoints, enrollment criteria agreed)
indications.trial_status: PORTOLA COMPLETED April 2025; topline March 2025 (50% CR vs 37.5% placebo by week 25); FDA alignment on Phase 2b achieved March 2026; company exploring strategic alternatives (announced Oct 2025) and implementing restructuring/wind-down
key_milestones: FDA Type C alignment on Phase 2b March 2026

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 2b trial (NCT05781750) TERMINATED Oct 2024 after FDA clinical hold based on safety monitoring committee review of 15 SAEs including 4 fatalities
Phase 2 (NCT04033926, OLE NCT04628936) COMPLETED; not in active pipeline
Phase 1 NCT05047536 enrollment stopped Aug 2024; Sec-61 program ceased; assets sold to Enodia Therapeutics SAS via asset purchase agreement March 6, 2026

company_status_note: Kezar announced Oct 2025 it would explore strategic alternatives focused on maximizing stockholder value after FDA misalignment on registrational AIH trial; implementing restructuring and wind-down. KZR-261 program sold to Enodia March 2026.
